page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is a general-purpose server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture with a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It provides 52 dedicated virtual CPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-core allocation of approximately 3.69 GB per vCPU. Networking throughput is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The instance contains no bundled local storage disks and includes zero GPUs, requiring persistent storage needs to be handled via external cloud storage volumes.

The balance between core count and memory density makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring sustained CPU throughput across dozens of parallel execution threads. Due to the lack of local NVMe storage, I/O performance relies on attached network block storage. The resource profile aligns with enterprise application backends, container orchestration nodes, multi-threaded batch processing, and mid-sized relational database environments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture at 2.5 GHz, delivering 52 dedicated virtual CPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory. This hardware allocation yields approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per vCPU, matching typical general-purpose design profiles. The instance operates without discrete GPU accelerators and contains no local storage volumes, requiring external network-attached cloud disks for data persistence and filesystem operations. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth capacity of 12 Gbps. The compute-to-memory balance and dedicated core allocation make ecs.g6.13xlarge appropriate for multi-threaded enterprise workloads, medium-scale database deployments, backend application clusters, batch processing, and high-concurrency web serving environments that rely on networked storage infrastructure.
